hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . 2>/dev/null || true

STATUS=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git status --short 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$STATUS" ] && jq -n --arg s "Uncommitted changes detected — please commit or stash before continuing:\n\n${STATUS}" '{systemMessage: $s}' || true
